decision_rule_reachability.reason: All four decision branches are concretely reachable on the frozen instrument. SUPPORTS was achieved by the DESIGN probe (R-SOUND T-CERT FA=0 cov=1.0; R-OVERWIDE T-CERT FA=0 REFUSED vs C-TRAINING-GATE FA=201). FALSIFIES is reachable: if the certificate adopted R-OVERWIDE, T-CERT would yield FA=201 (matching A-RAW-DECL). MIXED is reachable by a certificate that accepts some but not all sound declarations (coverage < 1.0, FA=0). MEASUREMENT_INVALID is reachable via carrier substitution, hash mismatch, regression failure, support drift, or any failing control. No branch is empty or arithmetically impossible; coverage ∈ [0,1], false-accept counts ∈ [0,404]; gate precedence does not shadow later branches.

control_sensitivity.reason: Every gated control has a reachable failure mode on the exact code path that produces the certificate. PC-CERT-ADMITS-SOUND fails if certify_declaration rejects a sound declaration (over-conservative detector). PC-CERT-REFUSES-OVERWIDE fails if it rubber-stamps the over-wide declaration. PC-CERT-REFUSES-UNDER fails if it rubber-stamps a too-narrow declaration. PC-INGEST-ABSTAIN fails if refusal does not restore the shipped support. PC-UNSAFE-RAW (A-RAW-DECL under R-OVERWIDE, FA=201) proves the safety oracle is not blind and the FALSIFIES branch is live. NC-REJECT-ALL proves the null floor (accept=0, http=0). B-SHIPPED and B-DECLARED-FULL anchor the coverage endpoints. BP-EVASION-CERT-PASS proves the boundary is genuinely reachable (certificate admits R-EVASION, arm false-accepts). The DESIGN probe exercised all of these with the real code path: certificate CERTIFIED 7/7 on R-SOUND, REFUSED 7/7 on R-OVERWIDE, REFUSED 7/7 on R-UNDER, CERTIFIED 7/7 on R-EVASION with FA=7; A-RAW R-OVERWIDE FA=201; NC HTTP=0. None is vacuous or tautological.

treatment_liveness.reason: The treatment is real shipped code (src/spider/kernel.py with ingest_declaration + module-level certify_declaration) installed by EXECUTE and exercised on the installed/materialized package. The DESIGN induction probe reproduced, for all seven families, a single-slot parameterized mechanism at confidence 0.9 ≥ 0.8 with support == EXPECTED_SHIPPED. After calling the real SpiderKernel.ingest_declaration with the sound declaration (R-SOUND), the certificate arm resolved all 120 IN items EXECUTABLE (coverage 1.0) with zero false rejects and issued 120 loopback HTTP requests, demonstrating the treatment structurally binds and executes. On refusal (R-OVERWIDE/R-UNDER) the same code path is exercised and preserves the shipped support (PC-INGEST-ABSTAIN). A structurally dead treatment would be caught by PC-EXACT-REPLAY (61/61 training IDs re-resolve EXECUTABLE on installed package) or by T-CERT R-SOUND coverage below 1.0 (MIXED) or MEASUREMENT_INVALID, never silently reported as a negative. The treatment bytes are frozen by POST_SHA256 and the install gate. Since this Product experiment targets C-PARAM-INHERIT, treatment_liveness must be PASS (not NOT_APPLICABLE) and it is.

nonblocking_findings: The DESIGN probe mode (EXP_PROBE_MODE=1) cannot exercise V8_FREEZE_BINDING against a real freeze.json (returns UNBOUND-RUN PASS). This is by design — the freeze.json will be created after this review passes. The actual EXECUTE will bind against the real freeze.json.

The carrier pre-state (718efa6a...) is the promoted carrier from EXP-PRODUCT-38180719830. An idempotent re-run would find the post-state (3a6caf97...) already installed; the runner handles this correctly by accepting either pre-state hash.

The frozen seven-family bank (524 items) is a local synthetic construction on a loopback oracle. V10-REPRESENTATION-LIMITS correctly bounds results to this bank and this installed carrier — not an end-to-end external-agent measurement.
rationale: All six satisfiability and identifiability checks PASS. The decision rule is total and every branch is reachable; all hard prerequisites are available at DESIGN time; baselines are identifiable and separate on the frozen regimes; all positive controls fire and the null control remains null on the same code paths; the treatment (real shipped kernel code with ingest_declaration + certify_declaration) is structurally live and executable on the installed package; and all mutable local dependencies are bound by freeze_artifacts or by pinned sha256 constants in the prereg. The DESIGN probe (EXP_PROBE_MODE=1) executed the exact FROZEN RUNNER against a hermetic materialization of the POST_KERNEL and produced SUPPORTS with all 22 gates PASS, confirming the design is not vacuous. No blocking findings. The experiment is ready for freeze.
